about: Hand-written objectives for quests whose scripted part scripts/data/lib/events.mjs cannot work out from the VMaNGOS world database alone, mostly because a VMaNGOS core (C++) script runs it, or because the database leaves a choice the quest text makes (which lockbox, which hot spot). Facts only: every id is a VMaNGOS creature, object, item or area trigger id, and every explicit point is a position from the VMaNGOS world database (spawns, area triggers, script rows) or from a core script, as each source says. VMaNGOS (world database and core, github.com/vmangos/core) is GPL-2.0-or-later; nothing here is copied from it but these facts. Entries here take precedence over the methods of events.mjs. quests: { id: { objectives: [{ kind, npc?, object?, item?, text, rq?, at?, points? }], giver?, ender?, source } } - rq is the index of the quests.json row the objective stands for; at says where it is done when that is not where its npc or object stands ({ npc | object | areatrigger: id or [ids], waypoint: [script_waypoint entry, point] }); giver and ender place a giver or ender with no fixed spot. skip: { id: reason } quests left out even if a method resolves them. text: { id: [line, ...] } better lines for what a method resolves, by objective (null keeps the method's line).
